# anchor meaning

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:anchorMeaning`](gmeow-anchorMeaning.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/anchorMeaning>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

What scores in this range MEAN — the calibration prose. NOT functional and range-open (localizable-prose convention): localizable prose may carry one meaning per language tag (sh:uniqueLang, SHACL) — a French and an English calibration coexist; two same-language meanings do not. Mandatory: an anchor without a meaning is just an interval.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry what scores in an anchor's range MEAN — the mandatory calibration prose, one per language tag.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it (an anchor without a meaning is just an interval) and avoid two same-language meanings on one anchor (sh:uniqueLang — though a French and an English calibration coexist).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:anchorMeaning`](gmeow-anchorMeaning.md) on the [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) with language-tagged prose; whose calibration judgement it is rides the statement layer.
